name: hn
title: Hacker News
description: New Hacker News front-page stories (50+ points) since the last run; notifies about the top one and shows "HN: N new" in the header.

name: feeds
title: RSS Feeds
description: Reads several RSS/Atom feeds (Lobsters, LWN, Ars Technica by default; edit the list at the top) and logs new items prefixed by feed name.

name: releases
title: GitHub Releases
description: Watches GitHub repositories for new releases and notifies you. Manage the list with `releases add owner/repo`, `releases rm owner/repo`, `releases list`.

name: reddit
title: Reddit Top Posts
description: Today's top 5 posts of a subreddit: `reddit [subreddit]` (default r/android).

name: weather
title: Weather
description: Current weather in one line from wttr.in: `weather [city]`, `weather --default <city>`. On a timer it pins the weather in the header.

name: forecast
title: 3-Day Forecast
description: Three-day forecast (conditions, min/max temperature, rain chance) from Open-Meteo: `forecast [city]`, `forecast --default <city>`.

name: sun
title: Sunrise & Sunset
description: Today's sunrise, sunset and day length for a saved location: `sun <city>` or `sun <lat> <lng>` to set it, then `sun`.

name: crypto
title: Crypto Prices
description: Coin prices with 24h change from CoinGecko: `crypto [ids…] [--vs eur]` (default bitcoin and ethereum in USD). On a timer it pins prices in the header.

name: exchange
title: Currency Converter
description: Converts currencies with daily rates: `exchange 100 usd inr eur`. On a timer it pins USD rates in the header.

name: ip
title: Public IP
description: Shows your public IP address (long-press to copy). On a timer it notifies when the IP changes, e.g. when a VPN drops.

name: wikipedia
title: Wikipedia
description: Summary of a Wikipedia article with its picture and a link to the full page: `wikipedia <topic>`, or a random article with no topic.

name: xkcd
title: xkcd
description: The latest xkcd comic, shown in the log with its alt text: `xkcd`, `xkcd <number>`, `xkcd random`. On a timer it notifies when a new comic is out.

name: quote
title: Quote of the Day
description: A random quote from ZenQuotes. On a timer it arrives as a notification.

name: countdown
title: Countdowns
description: Days until (or since) dates: `countdown 2026-12-25`, save with `countdown add 2026-12-25 Christmas`, list with `countdown`. Pins the nearest one in the header. No network.

name: todo
title: Todo List
description: A minimal todo list: `todo add <text>`, `todo done N`, `todo clear`, `todo` to list. Shows the open count in the header. No network.

name: charge-reminder
title: Charge Reminder
description: Runs when the charger is plugged in or out (@on charger, unplug): pins "charging since 14:02 (34%)" in the header, logs how much the battery gained, and notifies if you unplug below 30%. No network, no timer.
